// Build Store Prompt (PF2e) — shopkeeper + stocked inventory in one JSON payload const PRICE_BAND = {"0":{min:0,typical:5,max:5},"1":{min:10,typical:15,max:20},"2":{min:25,typical:30,max:35},"3":{min:45,typical:55,max:60},"4":{min:80,typical:100,max:125},"5":{min:140,typical:160,max:200},"6":{min:225,typical:250,max:300},"7":{min:340,typical:360,max:450},"8":{min:475,typical:500,max:650},"9":{min:650,typical:700,max:900},"10":{min:950,typical:1000,max:1400},"11":{min:1400,typical:1500,max:2000},"12":{min:2200,typical:2500,max:3000},"13":{min:2900,typical:3000,max:4500},"14":{min:4400,typical:4500,max:6500},"15":{min:6400,typical:6500,max:9500},"16":{min:9800,typical:10000,max:15000},"17":{min:15000,typical:15000,max:24000},"18":{min:23000,typical:24000,max:40000},"19":{min:40000,typical:40000,max:70000},"20":{min:70000,typical:70000,max:150000}}; const ITEM_COUNT = { village: 6, town: 8, city: 10, metropolis: 12 }; const STOCK_GUIDE = { general: 'everyday adventuring gear, tools, rope, rations, lanterns, packs; mostly mundane equipment and consumables', blacksmith: 'weapons (swords, axes, hammers, polearms), a few pieces of ammunition or weapon-adjacent gear; mostly weapon type', armorer: 'armor of various categories and shields; armor and shield types', alchemist: 'elixirs, potions, oils, poisons, alchemical bombs, mutagens; almost all consumable type', magic: 'wondrous equipment, wands, scrolls, talismans, magical trinkets; equipment and consumable types with the magical trait', jeweler: 'jewelry, gems, art objects, curiosities; treasure and equipment types', fletcher: 'bows, crossbows, arrows, bolts, quivers; weapon and equipment types', tavern: 'food, drink, lodging tokens, house specialties, a couple of quirky curios; consumable and treasure types, all low level', }; const { name, storeType, level, settlementSize, description } = $json; const count = ITEM_COUNT[settlementSize] || 8; const band = PRICE_BAND[String(Math.min(20, Math.max(0, level)))]; const lowLevel = Math.max(0, level - 2); const showcaseLevel = Math.min(20, level + 1); const SYSTEM_PROMPT = 'You are a PF2e Foundry VTT store designer. Return STRICT JSON only (no markdown, no prose, no code fences).\n' + 'Target system: Foundry VTT pf2e, Remaster era.\n\n' + 'TOP-LEVEL SHAPE:\n' + '{\n' + ' "name": "",\n' + ' "storeType": "' + storeType + '",\n' + ' "settlementSize": "' + settlementSize + '",\n' + ' "description": "<1-2 paragraphs of store flavour: the building, atmosphere, smells, clientele. PLAIN TEXT, no HTML>",\n' + ' "owner": { "name": "", "ancestry": "", "description": "<2-3 sentences: personality, appearance, a mannerism, a hook>" },\n' + ' "inventory": [ ]\n' + '}\n\n' + 'EACH INVENTORY ITEM SHAPE: { "name", "type", "img": "icons/svg/item-bag.svg", "system": {...} }\n' + 'Valid item types: weapon, armor, shield, equipment, consumable, treasure, backpack, book.\n\n' + 'UNIVERSAL SYSTEM FIELDS (every item):\n' + '- system.description = { "value": "

...

" } (HTML, 1 short paragraph, concrete numeric effects for magic items)\n' + '- system.level = { "value": }\n' + '- system.traits = { "value": [], "rarity": "common"|"uncommon"|"rare", "otherTags": [] }\n' + '- system.price = { "value": { "gp": N } } (use "sp"/"cp" keys for cheap goods)\n' + '- system.bulk = { "value": } (0 negligible, 0.1 Light)\n' + '- system.quantity = 1 (or a realistic stack for ammo/rations)\n' + '- system.size = "med"\n' + '- system.publication = { "title": "JamesCfer", "license": "ORC", "remaster": true }\n\n' + 'TYPE NOTES:\n' + '- weapon: system.category ("simple"|"martial"|"advanced"), system.group (sword/axe/bow/...), system.damage { "dice": 1, "die": "d4".."d12", "damageType": , "modifier": 0 }, system.runes { "potency": 0-3, "striking": 0-3, "property": [] }, system.usage { "value": "held-in-one-hand" }\n' + '- armor: system.category ("light"|"medium"|"heavy"), system.acBonus, dexCap, checkPenalty, speedPenalty, system.runes { "potency": 0-3, "resilient": 0-3, "property": [] }\n' + '- shield: system.acBonus, hardness, hp { "value", "max" }, system.runes { "reinforcing": 0-5 }\n' + '- equipment: system.usage { "value": "worn"|"wornring"|"wornamulet"|"held-in-one-hand" }\n' + '- consumable: system.category ("potion"|"elixir"|"oil"|"scroll"|"talisman"|"poison"|"snare"|"drug"|"other"), system.uses { "value": 1, "max": 1, "autoDestroy": true }\n' + '- treasure: system.stackGroup ("gems"|"coins"|null)\n\n' + 'REMASTER DAMAGE TYPES ONLY: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, bleed, acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, force, vitality, void, mental, poison, spirit.\n' + 'Magical items MUST include "magical" in traits.value. Runes only on items of level 2+ (potency 1 needs L2+, potency 2 needs L10+, striking needs L4+).\n' + 'FORBIDDEN PHRASES: "GM\'s discretion", "at the GM\'s option", "the GM may decide", "an unspecified benefit", "as appropriate".\n\n' + 'STOCK LEVEL RULES:\n' + '- Typical stock level: ' + level + '. Most items should be level ' + lowLevel + '-' + level + '.\n' + '- Include exactly ONE showcase item at level ' + showcaseLevel + ' — the shop\'s prize piece.\n' + '- Mundane staples (level 0) are welcome filler for general/tavern/fletcher stock.\n' + '- Level-' + level + ' items are typically priced around ' + band.min + '-' + band.max + ' gp; scale other items to their own level sensibly (L0 items cost silver/coppers to a few gp).\n' + '- No anachronisms, no modern names, no guns unless the description asks.'; const USER_PROMPT = 'Design a complete PF2e store for Foundry VTT.\n\n' + 'REQUEST:\n' + '- Store name: ' + name + '\n' + '- Store type: ' + STOCK_GUIDE[storeType] + '\n' + '- Typical stock level: ' + level + '\n' + '- Settlement: ' + settlementSize + ' (stock exactly ' + count + ' items)\n' + '- Description: ' + description + '\n\n' + 'DESIGN STEPS:\n' + '1. SHOPKEEPER: a memorable owner fitting the description (name, ancestry, 2-3 sentence sketch).\n' + '2. FLAVOUR: 1-2 paragraphs describing the store itself.\n' + '3. INVENTORY: exactly ' + count + ' items matching the stock guide, levels ' + lowLevel + '-' + level + ' plus one showcase at ' + showcaseLevel + '. Vary the types. Every magic item needs the "magical" trait and concrete numeric effects.\n' + '4. Every item gets system.publication.title = "JamesCfer".\n\n' + 'Return ONLY the JSON object.'; return [{ json: { ...$json, system: SYSTEM_PROMPT, user: USER_PROMPT, _targetCount: count } }];
